description: This file defines an interface 'ILogConsistencyProtocolServices' for log consistency and replication protocols used by log view adaptors in Orleans, along with a custom exception class 'ProtocolTransportException' related to protocol messaging errors.

classes.name: ProtocolTransportException
classes.description: A custom exception class used for protocol transport errors, derived from OrleansException, with serialization support.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the provided value.

methods.name: ProtocolError
methods.description: Logs an error message related to the log consistency protocol, with an option to throw an exception.

methods.name: CaughtException
methods.description: Logs an exception caught within the log consistency protocol.

methods.name: CaughtUserCodeException
methods.description: Logs an exception that occurred in user callback code, providing context.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Logs a message at a specified log level with formatting.
